summary: OpenAI announced that its models and Codex can now be accessed through Oracle Cloud using customers' existing Oracle cloud commitments.

categories.reason: The announcement is specifically about OpenAI models and Codex being distributed through Oracle Cloud using existing commitments, making the platform relationship itself the news.
categories.quote: Access OpenAI models and Codex through Oracle Cloud, using existing commitments to build and deploy AI with enterprise security and governance.

practices.reason: Teams using Oracle Cloud commitments gain a new route to access OpenAI models, which is an integration/availability change rather than a capability change.
practices.quote: Access OpenAI models and Codex through your Oracle cloud commitment.
